segments.source: New Features
segments.normalizedSource: New Features
segments.contextBefore: App Store Connect API version 1.2 provides resources that enable you to automate actions you take in App Store Connect.
segments.contextAfter: The new [`Apps`](apps.md) resource and the [`App Metadata`](app-metadata.md) collection of resources enable automating the creation of new app versions and managing app store information.
segments.documentTitle: App Store Connect API 1.2 release notes

segments.source: The new [`Apps`](apps.md) resource and the [`App Metadata`](app-metadata.md) collection of resources enable automating the creation of new app versions and managing app store information.
segments.normalizedSource: The new [`Apps`](apps.md) resource and the [`App Metadata`](app-metadata.md) collection of resources enable automating the creation of new app versions and managing app store information.
segments.contextBefore: New Features
segments.contextAfter: The new [`App Store Version Phased Releases`](app-store-version-phased-releases.md) resource enables automating the submission of new versions of your app to the App Store.
segments.documentTitle: App Store Connect API 1.2 release notes

segments.source: The new [`App Store Version Phased Releases`](app-store-version-phased-releases.md) resource enables automating the submission of new versions of your app to the App Store.
segments.normalizedSource: The new [`App Store Version Phased Releases`](app-store-version-phased-releases.md) resource enables automating the submission of new versions of your app to the App Store.
segments.contextBefore: The new [`Apps`](apps.md) resource and the [`App Metadata`](app-metadata.md) collection of resources enable automating the creation of new app versions and managing app store information.
segments.contextAfter: The [`Power and Performance Metrics and Logs`](power-and-performance-metrics-and-logs.md) now enables downloading of aggregate metrics and diagnostics for App Store versions of your app.
segments.documentTitle: App Store Connect API 1.2 release notes

segments.source: The [`Power and Performance Metrics and Logs`](power-and-performance-metrics-and-logs.md) now enables downloading of aggregate metrics and diagnostics for App Store versions of your app.
segments.normalizedSource: The [`Power and Performance Metrics and Logs`](power-and-performance-metrics-and-logs.md) now enables downloading of aggregate metrics and diagnostics for App Store versions of your app.
segments.contextBefore: The new [`App Store Version Phased Releases`](app-store-version-phased-releases.md) resource enables automating the submission of new versions of your app to the App Store.
segments.contextAfter: The [`Certificates`](certificates.md) resource now supports unified software signing and multiplatform app IDs, and the [`CapabilityType`](capabilitytype.md) has additional bundle ID capabilities.
segments.documentTitle: App Store Connect API 1.2 release notes
